name: Interior is open
statement: The interior of every subset of a metric space is open.
conditions: E is a subset of a metric space
typical_uses: Conclude that an interior is open.
common_misuses: Applying the rule to a different set-valued operation.

name: Rational powers are countable dense subsets
statement: Q^k is a countable dense subset of R^k for every positive integer k.
common_misuses: Omitting the positive-integer condition on k.

name: Monotone convergence theorem
statement: Every monotone bounded real sequence converges.
typical_uses: Conclude convergence after monotonicity and boundedness are established.
common_misuses: Using boundedness without monotonicity or monotonicity without boundedness.
